head: 2d85d89a82ae74aac74ac418cffb30287d163b3b
says: The kalfa test override sat after the terminology override, so its eslint/id-denylist replaced the terminology words for kalfa tests, and it turned no-cause-squash and written-service-type back on where next/'s tests have them off.
proof: Folding the overrides in order for kalfa/config/src/Codec.test.ts at 2d85d89a gives eslint/id-denylist ["error","where","why","what","who","how"], while next/packages/libfabrika/src/settings/Codec.test.ts on main gets the longer list with the terminology words; no-cause-squash and written-service-type fold to error for the kalfa test and off for the next/ test.
cost: kalfa tests could use the retired words with no lint error, and two rules next/'s tests are exempt from would block kalfa tests: the moved files are held to a different standard than before the move.
